verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's docs say passkeys are saved in its own vault and can be autofilled from the browser extension, mobile apps and desktop apps. That makes passkeys portable across clients rather than tied to one platform vendor, and Bitwarden itself provides it. But the evidence never names iOS, Android, Windows or Linux passkey support individually, and the cross-device passkey sync behavior is only implied, so the full extent is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit per-platform passkey support (iOS, Android, Windows, Linux), documented passkey sync behavior across devices, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-ecosystem passkey use.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor

citations.quote: Save passkeys in your Bitwarden vault and use the browser extension, mobile apps, or desktop apps to autofill them across the apps and websites you use every day.
